finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Ticket `fwrd71-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created (ref **RD-1015**, customer "Bench Customer", raised 2026-09-17), initially in status **Draft**.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Part `fwrd71-n1 RD Part A` added with cost 100 and markup 25. Computed price: **$125.00** (ticket total $125.00).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Part `fwrd71-n1 RD Part B` added with cost 200 and markup 25. Computed price: **$250.00** (ticket total rose to $375.00).

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup unchanged at 25). Computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (ticket total $437.50 = $187.50 + $250.00).

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Ticket ends in status **Ready**. The app's precondition, discovered by attempting "Mark Ready" and reading the verbatim error, was: *"Ticket is not ready"* with the unmet-condition list *"Part \"fwrd71-n1 RD Part A\" has no supplier"* and *"Part \"fwrd71-n1 RD Part B\" has no supplier"*. **Exactly what was required: every part on the ticket must have a supplier.** I set supplier "Acme Supplies" on both parts (costs/markups unchanged), then "Mark Ready" succeeded with no error — the status label read **Ready** and the available actions switched from "Mark Ready" to "Mark Draft"/"Mark Closed".

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Both parts deleted (each via its Delete action, confirming the in-page "Confirm" dialog with "Delete part"); the Parts section then read *"No parts on this ticket yet."* The ticket was then archived via "Archive ticket", which succeeded on the first attempt with no precondition or error message — the action changed to "Unarchive ticket" and an "Archived" badge appeared next to the title. Final verification: with archived hidden, searching "fwrd71" returns *"No tickets match the current filters."* (nothing from this run is active); with "Show archived" ticked, the row reads **RD-1015 | fwrd71-n1 RD Bench Ticket Archived | Bench Customer | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-17**.
